items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The guards are short and use the existing API (`if not self.field.is_cached(rel_obj):`). A clear comment explains each one ("Don't overwrite a value already cached, e.g. by a nested prefetch_related()"), and the formatting matches the surrounding code.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: It reuses the existing is_cached helper. However, the same guard and comment are pasted into three places, including ForwardManyToOneDescriptor.get_prefetch_queryset, which the issue doesn't need. That extra guard changes select_related identity behaviour, as the agent itself noted.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: It adds a simple conditional guard with no exception handling, no magic constants and nothing silently swallowed. The reverse relation is still set whenever it isn't cached.

items.name: Guard is conditional and covers the one-to-one variant
items.name_zh: 仅在已缓存时跳过回填，并考虑一对一情形
items.evidence: The reverse-FK manager is guarded with `if not self.field.is_cached(rel_obj)`, and ReverseOneToOneDescriptor gets the same guard via `self.related.field.is_cached`. The relation is still set when not cached, and the hidden tests pass.
